title: A unit section has a unique lift to an étale log structure
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and K an étale log structure [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], with its log axiom expressed on geometric stalks. For every étale X-scheme U [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and every unit a of Γ(U, O_U), there exists exactly one section m of K on U with α_K(m)=a. No logification or chosen presentation is assumed.

source.place: Exposé VI 1.1, printed p.69 (étale log conventions); explicit stalk-to-section argument for the log unit isomorphism, using Stacks Tags 03PT and 03PU, etale-cohomology.tex.

proof.text: For a ring unit section a on an étale test scheme U, at every geometric point of U the log stalk has a unique element over the germ of a: reflection of units and bijectivity of Units.map stalkAlpha give precisely this assertion. Represent that element on a pointed étale neighbourhood. Equality of its structural germ with the germ of a holds on a smaller pointed neighbourhood, by the filtered-colimit description of stalks. These neighbourhoods cover U.

proof.text: If two log sections have the same prescribed unit image, their germs at every geometric point are units by reflection of units. Injectivity on log-stalk unit groups makes those germs equal. Geometric stalks detect equality of sections (the injectivity part of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-iso-on-geometric-stalks]). Thus the locally constructed sections agree on overlaps. Glue them using the monoid-sheaf condition. Its structural image equals a because this is so on the cover and the étale structure presheaf is a sheaf (Scheme.isSheaf_etaleStructurePresheaf). The same germ argument proves uniqueness. On an empty test scheme the empty cover and the sheaf axiom give the unique section.

theorem EtaleLogStructure.existsUnique_unit_section_lift
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (K : EtaleLogStructure X)
    (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : (X.etaleStructurePresheaf.obj U)ˣ) :
    ∃! m : K.monoidSheaf.obj.obj U, K.alpha.app U m = a.val
